decisions.statement: An activity is started asking Apple for a token to push it at.
Every token the activity names is handed to the web layer as it arrives.
This plugin loads with the bridge, well before the web layer asks to hear it.
A token named before anything is listening is held until something takes it.
An activity still running when the app starts again is watched for a token.
One activity is watched once, however many times a start reaches it.
iOS refuses an activity asked for by a process it does not hold foreground.
A start refused that way is answered with no activity rather than a fault.

definition: the Swift starting, updating and ending the stoplights live activity
